name: Perfect Jeweller's Orb
description: Sets a Skill Gem to have 5 Support Gem Sockets
directions: Right click this item then left click a Skill Gem to apply it. Can only apply to Skill Gems with fewer than 5 Support Gem Sockets.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a skill gem to apply it. Can only apply to Skill Gems with fewer than 5 Support Gem Sockets.
